caption: The drawing depicts a metal object with a complex, symmetrical structure rendered in shades of yellow and gold, suggesting a brass material. The composition consists of three vertical elements supported on a base of three legs, each leg ending in a ball-shaped foot. The tallest vertical element, which is positioned on the right side, features a series of turned, ornamental segments culminating in a multi-faceted, domed finial. The two shorter vertical supports mirror each other, with similar ornamental turnings, and are positioned to the left and in the center. These shorter supports are connected by a curved horizontal bar that attaches to the base of the tallest element. The object is outlined with fine lines, and light shading is used to suggest dimensionality and reflections. The drawing is set against a plain, light background within a bordered rectangular frame. The name “HANS KORSCH” appears in block letters in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Andiron
